title: Linear upper bounds for the first Betti number of four-generated numerical semigroups
summary: A Lean 4 formalization, against Mathlib, of the theorem that the first Betti number (minimal number of generators of the toric ideal) of a numerical semigroup minimally generated by four elements n0 = 4 (an informal companion result; sharpness is not formalized).

review.reason: Lean formalization of linear bounds on Betti numbers for four-generated semigroups.
